regions.full_page: God bless you this glorious Feast and Easter Season, you and yours. May the divine Prince of Peace Himself breathe His Spirit of good will and harmoneous enlightenment on all and each of those unselfishly interested in Mercy-Hall activty, -- present, past, future. Glory be to God; what a record is not the story of that fair flower of Christian activity, and of practical Catholic action! -- a record of struggles sometimes bordering on the desperate, and of escapes, hair-splittingly close to disaster; struggles with and escapes from financial difficulties and bankruptcy, from envy and suspicion, from misunderstanding, calumny, etc. And some of all this in a way, before the idea of Mercy-Hall was fully conceived or its Heaven-sent "blue-prints" unfolded. -- as it was unfolded in that "miraculously" developed and unfading blooming slip of im- mortal from your Girl-Friend, Miss Daly's grave -- ) and it was de- finitely and urgently counseled: "Get started; if necessary, with a single patient in some old atic. God who loves tiny beginnings, will know as He always does know, how and when to provide develop- ment. " Ah! Blue prints? Struggles? Escapes? Crisis after crises? Thank God for them all. How wonderful with the inestimable gift of faith, whereby, with our cooperation, all and each such trial turn to have been blessings in disguise. Thank God too even for the present -- seemingly the supreme -- crisis.
